skill.label: ナチュラル／コンプレックスハーモニー

derivationRule: The current official Grade 2 TOC places natural harmony and complex harmony in scope. Two independently checked specialist-industry sources state the same nonvisual rule: natural harmony makes the hue nearer yellow lighter and the hue nearer blue-violet darker; complex harmony reverses that lightness relationship. This batch tests only that shared rule and its labels. It does not infer hue-distance limits, monitor colors, RGB/HEX, or diagram geometry.

コンプレックスハーモニー
トライアド
トーナル配色
questions.proposedAnswer: ナチュラルハーモニー
questions.explanation: ナチュラルハーモニーは、黄に近い側を明るく、青紫に近い側を暗くする自然な明度関係に従います。

qa.independentRecheck: re-read the two independent specialist-industry rules and matched yellow-near=lighter, blue-violet-near=darker to natural harmony before comparing with proposedAnswer
